description: This Python module provides utility functions for handling file storage operations such as saving uploaded files, retrieving file paths, deleting files, and saving byte content to files. It utilizes the FastAPI UploadFile type and references external configuration settings.

methods.name: get_storage_dir(kind)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the directory path for storing files of a given kind, creating the directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: save_upload_file(upload_file: UploadFile, kind: str)
methods.description: Saves an uploaded FastAPI file to the designated storage directory with a UUID-based filename and returns the file's ID and path.

methods.name: get_file_path(path)
methods.description: Returns the file system path for a given logical file path.

methods.name: delete_file_if_exists(path)
methods.description: Deletes the file at the specified path if it exists, ignoring any exceptions.

methods.name: save_file_bytes(bytes_content, out_path)
methods.description: Saves byte content to the specified output path and returns that path.
